annotations.text: Node model: 15 primitive agents from _STEP_FACTORY (config form generated from each Pydantic Step's field schema) + profiles/*.yaml component nodes (amber, collapsible subgraphs). stage: renders as the dashed group box, validation: as a badge on the node.

Timeline and event stream map 1:1 to the omni_ingest event bus: pipeline_begin, pipeline_step_begin, pipeline_step_progress (completed/total), pipeline_step_end, pipeline_end. Backend relays them over SSE.
